business_summary: Sanyo Engineering & Construction Inc. engages in the electric facility construction business in Japan and internationally. The company constructs drainage facilities, engages in internal wiring construction, power supply construction, and air conditioning supply construction. It also offers indoor and outdoor electrical equipment construction, internal communication equipment construction, designs and constructs electrical and instrumentation equipment construction and installation, power transmission and distribution line construction, power generation and transformation facilities, air conditioning equipment construction, water supply and drainage equipment, high and low voltage distribution boards, various distribution boards, distribution boards, control boards, monitoring boards, operation panels, etc. Additionally, it sells and maintains electrical equipment, and generates solar power. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Sanyo Engineering & Construction Inc.는 일본 및 해외에서 전기 시설 건설 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 배수시설 건설, 내부배선 공사, 전원공사, 공조공급공사 등을 영위하고 있습니다. 또한 실내외 전기설비 공사, 내부 통신설비 공사, 전기 및 계장설비 공사 및 설치, 송배전선로 공사, 발전 및 변전설비, 공조설비 공사, 상하수도 설비, 고저압 배전반, 각종 분전반, 분전반, 제어반, 감시반, 운전반 등의 설계 및 시공을 하고 있으며, 전기설비 판매 및 유지보수, 태양광 발전사업도 하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 1937년에 설립되었으며 일본 도쿄에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
